Ben — internal notes for the DPA redlines (high-level):

1) Data export & assistance: tighten scope so assistance obligations apply to requests tied to security incidents or regulatory obligations; avoid broad discovery-style requests.
2) Processor obligations: add explicit reference to SCCs + mapping to our security controls, including the KV-cache and encryption at rest language we already provide.
3) Audit & evidence: we will provide SOC2 Type II and an extract of the subprocessor list; carveouts for trade secret and 3P data should remain.

UK IDTA: recommend we include the standard bridging clause and execute the IDTA addendum concurrently. Operationally, Monica should create a single DocuSign envelope that contains: DPA (with countersignature page) + UK IDTA addendum + SCCs execution acknowledgement.

I also recommend we prepare a short transfer-impact note (one page) to attach to the envelope noting: jurisdictions, subprocessors impacted, and mitigations (encryption/contractual controls).
